verdict.rationale: Letta documents a programmatic Agent SDK for driving agents in depth. It covers creating agents (`client.createAgent()`), resuming sessions, sending messages and streaming typed events, and approving tool calls via a `canUseTool` callback. The App Server also exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and an ACP adapter, and headless CLI mode supports scripting. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/REST spec (the probe found 404 at standard paths), no independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
